verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents three headless paths: an official CLI that manages flags, segments, projects and environments from the terminal; an Admin API covering everything the dashboard can do; and an MCP server explicitly described as usable 'fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline.' Docker-based local environments also support scripted setups. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage, explicit CI guidance for the CLI itself (non-interactive auth/tokens), and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Flagsmith CLI lets you manage flags, segments, features, projects and environments from your terminal, and evaluate flags the way an SDK would.
Your assistant can manage feature flags, segments, multivariate options, and release workflows on your behalf — in a human-in-the-loop IDE session, or fully automated in a CI/CD pipeline.
Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API.
The CLI covers flags, segments, features, organisations, projects, environments, SDK-style flag evaluation, and raw API access.
